arguments.query: SELECT event_id, status, attempts, payload FROM outbox ORDER BY event_id;
SELECT event_id, status, attempts, payload FROM outbox WHERE status IN (pending, quarantined) ORDER BY event_id;
SELECT event_id, status, attempts, payload FROM outbox WHERE status = "pending" OR status = "quarantined" ORDER BY event_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(DISTINCT client_reference) as unique_refs FROM bookings WHERE status = "confirmed";
SELECT booking_id, client_reference, status FROM bookings WHERE status = "confirmed" LIMIT 5;

SELECT b.booking_id, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "confirmed" GROUP BY b.booking_id HAVING charge_count > 0 LIMIT 5;
SELECT f.flight_id, f.capacity, COUNT(h.hold_id) as hold_count FROM flights f LEFT JOIN holds h ON f.flight_id = h.flight_id GROUP BY f.flight_id HAVING hold_count > f.capacity;
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" AND name="holds";
SELECT f.flight_id, f.capacity, COUNT(h.booking_id) as hold_count FROM flights f LEFT JOIN holds h ON f.flight_id = h.flight_id GROUP BY f.flight_id HAVING hold_count > f.capacity;
SELECT charge_id FROM charges WHERE booking_id NOT IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings);
SELECT booking_id, COUNT(*) as charge_count FROM charges WHERE status = "captured" GROUP BY booking_id HAVING charge_count > 1;
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" AND name="charges";
SELECT booking_id, COUNT(*) as charge_count FROM charges WHERE state = "captured" GROUP BY booking_id HAVING charge_count > 1;
SELECT b.booking_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id WHERE b.status = "confirmed" AND (c.booking_id IS NULL OR c.state != "captured");

SELECT b.booking_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id LEFT JOIN checkins ck ON b.booking_id = ck.booking_id WHERE b.status = "confirmed" AND (h.booking_id IS NULL OR ck.booking_id IS NULL);
